title.zh: 【Lightning Labs CTO 建议更新 lnd 及 btcd 等节点软件】
title.en: 【Lightning Labs CTO 建议更新 lnd 及 btcd 等节点软件】

current_state.zh: Lightning Labs CTO Olaoluwa Osuntokun urged all lnd, btcd, tapd and litd users to update binaries or rebuild with Go 1.27.3 due to CVE-2026-111943, a certificate-authority compromise affecting the software's security.
